prompts.motion: Use the provided start image as the first frame and the provided end image as the final frame anchor. The person shrinks and stiffens as their skin takes on a smooth painted-plastic sheen and visible toy joints appear at the shoulders and knees. A clear plastic blister shell snaps closed around them and a bright cardboard backing slides in behind, sealing them in the package. The camera pulls back slightly to reveal the whole box. Audio: A playful plastic clicking, a whoosh, and a satisfying blister-pack snap.
prompts.endFrame: Turn the person into a glossy plastic collectible action figure sealed inside a retail blister package: a clear plastic bubble over a colourful cardboard backing with bold graphic shapes and a hanging tab, small accessories in moulded slots beside the figure. The figure keeps the person's outfit, hairstyle and pose with visible toy joints and painted details. No brand names or logos.
